verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The Indian government is not offering a 3-month free mobile recharge. Messages claiming this are scams designed to steal personal information.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple fact-checking organizations and the Indian government's Press Information Bureau (PIB) have repeatedly debunked claims of a free mobile recharge scheme from the Prime Minister. The evidence shows these are recurring hoaxes that use malicious links to defraud people and steal personal data. Some viral videos promoting this scam have been identified as edited or created with AI.
